name: Hilde Vautmans - § 5 - Am 36
title: REPORT on a European Parliament recommendation to the Council, the Commission and the Vice-President of the Commission / High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy concerning EU-China political relations
part_text: 5. Urges EU Member States and institutions to avoid political fragmentation and to adopt a unitary and coordinated strategy to diplomatically and firmly engage with China, protect the EU’s geopolitical and economic interests, promote human rights, and pursue mutually beneficial cooperation; raises concerns about the potential national security implications, and their ramifications at European level, arising from the judicial investigations concerning former Spanish Prime Minister José Luis Rodríguez Zapatero and his alleged connections with Chinese state-linked commercial entities, and transactions involving strategic natural resources; welcomes the resumption of interparliamentary dialogue with the Chinese National People’s Congress; calls for full transparency and reciprocity in all parliamentary exchanges, including safeguards for Members expressing their legitimate views;
